description: A React functional component implementing a persistent music playback control bar with playback controls, shuffle, repeat, and volume adjustment.

methods.name: handlePlayPause
methods.description: Handles toggling between play and pause states by dispatching 'PAUSE' or 'PLAY' actions.

methods.name: handleSkip
methods.description: Handles skipping tracks forwards or backwards based on 'direction' parameter.

methods.name: handleVolume
methods.description: Handles changing the volume by dispatching 'SET_VOLUME' with new volume level.
